format: NDCA Sanctioned events, uncontested single-couple entry

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Where only one couple is entered in a single or multi dance event, that couple is the de facto winner and must receive a 1st place mark.

requirement: Before an NDCA profile is enabled, define how an uncontested entry receives a first-place mark, and how that interacts with III.D.6 and with DanceFlow's refusal of single-couple scored Finals.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI.
interpretation_notes: Read together with III.D.6, one couple may be an event that is not accepted as bona-fide competition yet still earns a first-place mark; the text does not say how the two fit, so this is recorded as requires_interpretation, not as a contradiction. DanceFlow Studio refuses a single-couple scored Final (OD21-DF-0001); that is policy and would not satisfy III.D.8. Edition difference vs July 2026 is UNVERIFIED (not covered by PR 840).
decision_refs: OD-21 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve Studio/Custom minimum-participation and withdrawal rules for initial activation; retrospective audit PR #795)
